verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party AI assistant that generates or improves agent prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. The prompting docs describe users writing system prompts themselves. The MCP server and llms.txt give external AI coding tools access to Deepgram's APIs and docs, which is an adjacent building block, not the platform's own authoring AI.
